title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：tool　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tool 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the craftsman ① used the tool that no apprentice in the workshop would have described, and he said the using was the whole of the year. The ② tool, meaning the instrument itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a tool, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tool in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ tool at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tool, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the craftsman said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tool was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the instrument. The ⑥ tool, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tool, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both an instrument and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ tool had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ tool of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of describing; tool, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tool I remember is the instrument described in the ledger, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ tool, my mother said in 2001, is the only instrument that improves by being described; every tool, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工具（指工坊里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 工具（指那件工具本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the tool 用这一件工具
D. n. 工具（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 工具之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的工具之事）
F. n. 工具（指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一件）
G. n. 工具、本事（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: use the tool 意为“用这一件工具”，1992 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯描述的一件工具做了一遍。
tool 意为“工具”，指那件工具本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
tool 意为“工具”，指工坊里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
tool 意为“工具”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tool 意为“工具、本事”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件本事就是那件事的全部。
tool 意为“本事”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件工具，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tool 意为“工具”，指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一件，到 1997 年这一件成了工料簿里的一行。
tool 意为“工具之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的工具之事是一处工坊和三个年头的描述。
tool 意为“工具”，我记得的是工料簿里描述过的那一件，1999 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一件。
tool 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，工具是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的工具。
